# Check EWS response cardinality before pairing responses with requested IDs

The well-known-folder request checks response count against EXCHANGE_DISTINGUISHED_IDS before zipping the two sequences. A zip alone would silently stop at the shorter sequence. Preserve that count check in this ordered mapping. The adjacent comment explicitly says EWS documentation is not clear about response order; the code assumes request order because there is no other mapping field. The inspected code does not independently prove server ordering. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build or live accessibility validation was run. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.

Scope: EWS well-known folder response mapping.
